question: Why were drug administrations stopped? For each reason (side effect, ineffective, medical aim achieved, patient dislikes the drug, to avoid an interaction, too expensive, drug resistance, death, new diagnosis, lost to follow-up, or other) give the number of administrations and of patients.
note: Drug administration events and patients per reason-to-stop code (eleven SNOMED codes).
reference_sparql:
PREFIX sphn: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn#>
PREFIX snomed: <http://snomed.info/id/>

SELECT ?reason_to_stop
       (COUNT(DISTINCT ?administration) AS ?administrations)
       (COUNT(DISTINCT ?g) AS ?patients)
WHERE {
  GRAPH ?g {
    ?administration a sphn:DrugAdministrationEvent ;
                    sphn:hasReasonToStopCode ?reason_code .
    ?reason_code a ?reason_concept .
  }
  VALUES (?reason_concept ?reason_to_stop) {
    (snomed:395009001 "side effect")
    (snomed:395007004 "ineffective")
    (snomed:182846007 "medical aim achieved")
    (snomed:182844005 "patient dislikes the drug")
    (snomed:182845006 "to avoid an interaction")
    (snomed:182872003 "too expensive")
    (snomed:31438003  "drug resistance")
    (snomed:419620001 "death")
    (snomed:441308009 "new diagnosis")
    (snomed:399307001 "lost to follow-up")
    (snomed:74964007  "other")
  }
}
GROUP BY ?reason_to_stop
ORDER BY DESC(?administrations)

question: For each year from 2015 to 2024, how many therapeutic ultrasound procedures were billed and how many patients had one?
note: Billed procedures under CHOP 00.0 (therapeutic ultrasound, with inference) per start year 2015-2024: procedures and patients.
reference_sparql:
PREFIX sphn: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn#>
PREFIX chop: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/chop/>

SELECT ?year
       (COUNT(DISTINCT ?procedure) AS ?procedures)
       (COUNT(DISTINCT ?g) AS ?patients)
WHERE {
  GRAPH ?g {
    ?code a chop:00.0 OPTION (inference "https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/global") .
    ?procedure sphn:hasCode ?code .
    ?procedure a sphn:BilledProcedure ;
               sphn:hasStartDateTime ?start .
  }
  BIND (YEAR(?start) AS ?year)
  FILTER (?year >= 2015 && ?year <= 2024)
}
GROUP BY ?year
ORDER BY ?year

question: When a therapeutic ultrasound is billed, how often is the treated body site on the left, on the right, on both sides, or on one unspecified side? Give procedures and patients per side.
note: Billed therapeutic ultrasound procedures (CHOP 00.0 with inference) and patients per laterality of the body site.
reference_sparql:
PREFIX sphn: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn#>
PREFIX snomed: <http://snomed.info/id/>
PREFIX chop: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/chop/>

SELECT ?side
       (COUNT(DISTINCT ?procedure) AS ?procedures)
       (COUNT(DISTINCT ?g) AS ?patients)
WHERE {
  GRAPH ?g {
    ?code a chop:00.0 OPTION (inference "https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/global") .
    ?procedure sphn:hasCode ?code .
    ?procedure a sphn:BilledProcedure ;
               sphn:hasBodySite ?body_site .
    ?body_site sphn:hasLaterality ?laterality .
    ?laterality sphn:hasCode ?laterality_code .
    ?laterality_code a ?laterality_concept .
  }
  VALUES (?laterality_concept ?side) {
    (snomed:7771000  "left")
    (snomed:24028007 "right")
    (snomed:51440002 "both sides")
    (snomed:66459002 "one side, unspecified")
  }
}
GROUP BY ?side
ORDER BY DESC(?procedures)
